gemAtlas.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset: a 3 by 3 sprite sheet of NINE separate premium gemstone game-button objects, informed by the attached gem reference, color chart, cut shapes and four-leaf clover pendants. EXACT layout: 3 equal columns and 3 equal rows, nine equally sized square cells, perfectly aligned centers. Transparent background, no grid, no text, labels, numerals, metal, gold borders, prongs, chains, pendants or other items. Each gemstone is isolated with generous clear margins, occupies about 72 percent of its cell width and height. All are front facing with subtle convincing depth and the same soft upper-left studio light. Primary requirement: very quiet, broad, clean, almost uniform center occupying at least the central 55 percent of each stone, so large code-rendered numbers remain very readable. Soft polished cabochon/step-cut surfaces with just a FEW broad facets confined to the outside rim. NO shattered glass appearance, crystal noise, tiny triangular facets, glitter, internal fractures, sharp white reflected triangles, checkerboard. Restrained elegant luminosity with soft edge highlights. Specifically by cell: row1 col1 creamy OFF-WHITE IVORY ROUND cabochon; row1 col2 rich deep BURGUNDY OVAL; row1 col3 dark EMERALD GREEN chamfered rectangular emerald cut; row2 col1 deep ROYAL BLUE ROUND cut with a few perimeter facets; row2 col2 soft BLUSH PINK PEAR/teardrop pointing up; row2 col3 AQUAMARINE/AQUA classic FOUR-LEAF CLOVER QUATREFOIL like supplied pendant: four clearly round symmetric lobes at top, right, bottom and left, concave waists, NO stem, a wide smooth center; row3 col1 muted AMETHYST purple rounded-square CUSHION; row3 col2 warm HONEY AMBER horizontal MARQUISE pointed oval, wide enough for numbers; row3 col3 deep TEAL HEXAGON. These are beautiful full material 3D-rendered jewelry stones, not flat vector icons, and not extra-reflective diamonds. No gold edge on any object: code will award a separate gold edge only upon completion. Make all nine unique, distinct, quiet and equally prominent. Square high-resolution atlas.
gemAtlas.outcome: RGB output with a painted checkerboard; not used directly
